identity.title: Timeline of events in Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl

leadText: In , Ash Ketchum arrives in the Sinnoh region with his and meets , a new aspiring to become a Top Pokémon Coordinator. Joined by his old , the trio s through Sinnoh as Ash aims to collect eight Gym Badges for the Sinnoh League, while Dawn participates in Pokémon Contests. Along the way, Ash has his ideologies as a Trainer challenged by his newest rival, Paul, and the trio gets involved in a plot schemed by the villainous Team Galactic, linking their journey with the fate of the entire Sinnoh region.
